summary: This bill amends IRC section 7508A to let the IRS postpone federal tax deadlines for state-declared natural disasters when requested by a governor (after FEMA consultation) and extends the maximum mandatory postponement period from 60 to 120 days.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses federal tax deadlines, expanding the circumstances under which they can be postponed for taxpayers affected by disasters. While it doesn't change tax rates or overall tax burden, it modifies the administration of tax collection, making it more flexible for certain taxpayers.
